title: Faster through one opening
hook: Change fluid speed and predict volume-flow rate.
misconception: volume-flow rate stays fixed when fluid speed doubles.
objective: Apply Q = Av to compare volume-flow rate when fluid speed changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With uniform flow across a fixed cross-sectional area, Q = Av. When fluid speed doubles, volume-flow rate becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = Av; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider uniform flow across a fixed cross-sectional area, with a nonzero initial result. If fluid speed triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on volume-flow rate?
recall.why: Apply Q = Av under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
